The scan crashed on fork PRs because of how GitHub handles secrets, and the fix was PR #6210. I could not find a ticket key for that fix.

**Why only fork PRs:** Before the fix, the workflow ran on `pull_request` against `master` with no path filter, so every PR triggered it. The Dependency-Check step passed `--nvdApiKey ${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }}` unconditionally. GitHub does not expose repository secrets to workflows triggered by fork PRs, so the secret expanded to an empty string and the CLI received `--nvdApiKey` with no value. Same-repo PRs and pushes had the secret and worked. The flag was added in #5784 (`88b84fef`).

**How it runs now:** Commit `8ec94d21` (PR #6210) changed the argument to `${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY != '' && format('--nvdApiKey {0}', secrets.NVD_API_KEY) || '' }}`. When the key is present, the flag is passed. When it is absent, the expression is empty, the flag is omitted, and the scan runs without an NVD key. Commit `be871678` then removed the PR runs entirely, so the workflow now triggers only on pushes to `master` and `2.*.x` branches.

**Ticket:** The fix commit and its PR message carry no ticket key, and Falkon only shows unverified keys parsed from messages. I found no `TRUNK-` key for this change, so I have left the ticket out of the list below.
